desc:
• CRISPY CORN SNACKS: Bugles, the first cone-shaped corn snack; Bugles Original features crispy, salty, melt-in-the-mouth goodness and contains no trans fat

  • PANTRY AND PARTY FAVORITE: A pantry staple that's delicious alone or added to your favorite snack mix recipes; The ultimate snacking chips

  • ON-THE-GO SNACK: Light, airy and uniquely crunchy snacks perfect for the lunchbox or a grab and go snack as you head out the door

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Create fun recipes with this simple snack; Adds satisfying flavor to snack bags or the office snack drawer; Makes delicious fun for both kids and kids at heart

  • CONTAINS: three oz
features:
Features

Iconic cone shape: Funnel-shaped corn snacks that are fun to eat and perfect for dipping.

Classic salted corn flavor: Lightly seasoned with sea salt for simple, satisfying taste.

Crispy and airy texture: Made from cornmeal and cooked in vegetable oil to provide a hearty crunch without unpleasant heaviness.

No trans fats or cholesterol: A lighter alternative to many fried snacks.

Portable packaging: Comes in a single-serve 3 oz bag—ideal for on-the-go snacking and portion control. 

 Benefits

Playful eating experience: The unique cone shape makes snacking interactive and enjoyable — perfect for kids and grown-ups alike.

Light yet flavorful: Delivers satisfying crunch and classic corn taste without being greasy or overpowering.

Kitchen convenience: Ready-to-eat with no prep needed—just open and enjoy.

Healthier snacking option: Free of trans fats and cholesterol, making these a smarter crunchy snack.

Pack-friendly: Easy to carry in backpacks, lunchboxes, or tote bags—ideal for school, work, or travel.

Crowd-pleasing: Great for casual gatherings, parties, picnics, and game nights.
ingredients: Ingredients: Degermed Yellow Corn Meal, Vegetable Oil (coconut and/or palm kernel), Sugar, Salt, Baking Soda. Freshness Preserved by BHT.
